root_idea.summary: Directed seeking: turning attention or effort toward finding, obtaining, or attaining something, whether concrete or abstract.
root_idea.development: From the basic notion of seeking arise the seeker and the sought object, requests and demands, assistance in fulfilling a request, and derived descriptions of things made remote or difficult to reach and therefore requiring pursuit.

senses.definition: To seek or search for something in order to find, obtain, or take it.
senses.usage_conditions: An active Form I verb; the Quranic occurrence expresses pursuit of an object, here represented by an object pronoun. The object may be concrete or abstract.

senses.definition: Seeking or searching for something, including examining whether it exists, in order to find or obtain it.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun covering the search for a concrete or abstract object; the Quranic usage concerns seeking something that may have become inaccessible.

senses.definition: One who seeks, pursues, or desires something; a seeker.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle used substantively for the participant engaged in seeking, and capable of standing in contrast with the sought object.

senses.definition: That which is sought, desired, or demanded; the sought object or person.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle used substantively for the goal or object of seeking, in contrast with the seeker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask for, petition for, or demand something from someone; with بِحَقٍّ, to pursue a right, due, or blood-revenge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The request or demand may be construed with مِنْ or إِلَى; the latter can express petitioning or asking someone. This is a constructional extension of seeking and demanding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a lamp or lighted wick, to be near or about to go out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical construction in which the subject is an inanimate light.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become distant or remote.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Form I vocalization and lexical use from the ordinary seeking verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fulfill, provide, or accomplish for someone what they sought or demanded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative use directed toward the requested or desired object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To help or assist someone in seeking a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative use in which the subject facilitates another person's search.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone need to seek or demand something; to necessitate seeking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Form IV use has a causative sense opposite in direction to the use meaning to fulfill a request.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, pasture, or herbage, to become distant or remote so that it must be sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV use describing something made difficult to reach by its remoteness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand repeatedly, diligently, or earnestly, making successive efforts to obtain something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V intensification of seeking; the effort may also be described as deliberate or sustained rather than necessarily hurried.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be suitable, fitting, meet, or proper for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive Form VII use, as though the thing were sought, desired, or desirable; it is also reported in a Quranic interpretive explanation, though no corresponding QAC Form VII group is supplied here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A far-extending journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use, synonymous with an extended journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of seeking or demanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A deverbal noun of modality rather than the ordinary verbal noun for seeking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eagle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed lexical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing sought, desired, demanded, or requested; an object of quest, need, love, or a right or due to be claimed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal object of seeking or demand, including a needed thing or an entitlement pursued from another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or assembly of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported lexical use attributed to one authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who seeks, desires, or demands much or often; an intensive description of a seeker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective, with related intensive forms recorded alongside it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well whose water is remote and must be sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to a well according to the remoteness of its water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A student or seeker of knowledge or science.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized use, especially in the expression طَالِبُ عِلْمٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of seeking; especially a place where something buried, remarkable, or sought in a book is located.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation of the setting or occasion in which a search is made.

other_classical_meanings.definition: By extension, a person from whom one seeks a thing or the fulfillment of a desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed-tropical extension from a place or occasion of seeking to a sought source of fulfillment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distant or remote, especially of water, pasture, or herbage that can be reached only after seeking; also applied to other remote things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of remoteness that makes the object sought or difficult to attain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand or prosecute someone for a thing due to one; to claim a right, debt, or blood-revenge from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction in which a person is pursued for a due, claim, debt, or other thing demanded from him; the demand does not necessarily imply that the claim is just.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Seeking is represented in the Quranic verb; asking, demanding, and pursuing a due are separately represented classically.
Separate Form I sense of becoming remote.
Form III demand or prosecution for a due.
Form IV fulfillment and assistance in seeking.
Form IV causative necessity to seek.
Form IV remote water or pasture.
Specialized meaning of an extended journey.
Cross-reference to the defined طَلِبَة entry.
Object of seeking, desire, need, or demand.
Reported meaning of a company or assembly.
Pointer to the preceding nominal discussion.
General seeker is represented in the Quranic participle; student is separately represented as a Classical specialization.
Tropical extension to a person from whom fulfillment is sought.
Remote water, pasture, herbage, or other things.

cautions: The Form VII suitability sense is explicitly connected in the lexical evidence with an interpretation of a Quranic passage, but no corresponding Form VII QAC form group is supplied; it is therefore retained under broader Classical meanings rather than attached to a Quranic form.
The historical Quran citation associated with that Form VII discussion is not converted into a modern verse example because the corresponding QAC location is absent from this packet.
